intro.brandSub: Gateway for learning, training, and development
intro.h1: Want to know how far your Arabic reaches? It is clearer than you think. We are here.
intro.lead: This is a challenge of five rings, not an email form. After it, a free comprehensive test brings you closer to learning Arabic and mastering it. Levels follow the CEFR, from A1 to C2.
intro.p1: Five rings on the seal reveal a first trace.
intro.p2: The full test is open now, with no fee.
intro.p3: Knowing where you stand is the first step in learning.
intro.sealCap: Press the gold center. Then answer. A new ring stays on the seal.
intro.voice0: Touch the seal, or start from here. Each answer prints a ring, and the ring brings you closer to the comprehensive test.
intro.after: This is the trace of the challenge, not mastery yet. Mastery begins when you ask to enter the free comprehensive test.
intro.sideK: What does knowing your level mean?
intro.sideH: Not a label. A place to start.
intro.side: Not to label you, but to show where learning starts. Athar then opens programs, simulations, kits, and live sessions.
intro.lvH: Six levels. Each one said once.
intro.sampleNote: Each Arabic line is a sample from that level.
intro.a1: You know yourself, and you know others.
intro.a2: You ask for what you need, and you understand the reply.
intro.b1: You tell what happened, and you explain your view.
intro.b2: You discuss a matter, and you tell two possibilities apart.
intro.c1: You build a longer idea, and you order its reasons.
intro.c2: You grasp what was not said plainly, and you rebuild it.
intro.learnK: Do you want to learn Arabic and master it?
intro.learnH: After the level is set … the path to mastery.
intro.learn: The free comprehensive test does not stop at a number. It opens what is in the Athar gateway: a program, a simulation, a kit, and a live session.
intro.progS: Your path after you know your level.
intro.simS: Try the situation before you enter it.
intro.kitS: Material you return to after the result.
intro.compS: The full picture, and a report that brings you closer to mastery.
intro.adapS: A shorter road. It stops where your level becomes clear.
intro.examH: The questions change with the skill.
intro.examNote: You chose {door}. The skill here is different from the rings.
intro.title: Athar — where your Arabic stands

register.title: Register to enter the test
register.lead: Your details open a secure session. Then the test begins.
register.name: Full name
register.privacy: Your details are used only for this session and your report.
register.errRetake: You have already taken Miaar. A new attempt needs the academic director’s approval.
register.errSession: A session is already open, or a new one could not start. Refresh to resume.
register.errCheck: We could not check whether you may start. Try again.
register.errNet: We could not reach the test. Check your connection and try again.
register.errGeneric: The secure session could not start. Try again.

test.started: The test has started — you have {n} minutes
test.half: About half the time has passed — 30 minutes left
test.m10: 10 minutes left — review your deferred questions
test.m2: Two minutes left — finish your answers
test.last: Last minute — your test will be submitted automatically
test.deferredHead: Deferred questions in {level} — tap to open
test.toReviewHint: Your answers are shown before the result is confirmed
test.toPrint: End now and print the report
test.toPrintHint: Skips review and opens the print window
test.sure: Are you sure? The test ends now, without review.
test.reviewing: You are reviewing — change your answer, then return to the list
test.comprehensive: Comprehensive: items from every level are shown.
test.adaptive: Adaptive: the move-on rate from {level} is {pct}%.
test.shortcuts: Shortcuts: 1–4 to choose, Enter for next, D to defer.
test.lastQ: This is the last question left in the level — answer it to finish the level.
test.tipMark: Mark for later review without losing the answer
test.tipDefer: Defer the question and return to it automatically

result.title: Placement report
result.saved: The result was saved automatically. This is the summary. The answer key is not shown.
result.masteryNote: Counted only on the questions you actually reached.
result.restart: Restart the test from the beginning
result.savedNote: Your result was saved automatically. You can view it later from the admin panel.
result.emailLead: Your mail app will open with the report summary ready to send.
result.a1: Beginner — you understand simple daily phrases
result.b1: Intermediate — you handle varied situations clearly
result.b2: Upper intermediate — you discuss and express yourself with some fluency
result.c1: Advanced — you use the language with academic and professional flexibility
result.c2: Mastery — close to a native speaker
result.reasonFail: Adaptive stop — the move-on rate was not met

gate.title: Five questions. Then the choice is yours.
gate.resultKicker: Short report · not an official placement
gate.noteA1: You started with short phrases. The full test will show whether your level is higher than this sample.
gate.noteA2: You handle familiar sentences. The real challenge is measuring reading and listening together.
gate.noteB1: A middle indicator from only five items. It is not enough to place a program.
gate.noteB2: Strong work in this sample. The detailed report is what separates the skills.
gate.noteC1: An advanced sample, but only five questions. It is not an official placement.
gate.touch: This is only a first touch. Register to try the full test and open Athar programs and tools.

review.title: Review your answers
review.lead: Review your answers before the result is confirmed. Tap any question to return and change it.
review.tap: Tap any question to return to it
review.pending: You have {n} unanswered questions. They will count as wrong if you confirm now.
review.continue: Continue the test for the remaining levels
review.confirm: Confirm the result and show the report
review.reasonFail: Adaptive stop — the move-on rate was not met
